data.title: Atelis
data.about:
Atelis by Meraas is a waterfront residential development located in the heart of Dubai Design District (d3). Rising gracefully along the Creekside shoreline, Atelis offers a premium selection of 1 to 4-bedroom apartments, exclusive 4-bedroom sky villas, and ultra-luxurious 5-bedroom penthouses.

Designed by the world-renowned architectural firm Skidmore, Owings & Merrill (SOM)—the creative minds behind the Burj Khalifa—Atelis promises residents breathtaking views of the Dubai skyline and serene waterfront. At the ground level, the development features cascading water elements, lush garden rooms, and tranquil indoor-outdoor lounges, all curated to offer a sense of privacy and refined exclusivity.

Just minutes from Downtown Dubai, City Walk, and Business Bay, Atelis is the ideal choice for those who value connectivity, creativity, and sophisticated urban living. It presents a thoughtfully curated lifestyle that blends the serenity of resort-style living with the vibrancy of a dynamic city setting.

characteristics_module.title: Live in Style - Atelis at Dubai Design District (D3) by Meraas
characteristics_module.heading: Unique Selling Points
characteristics_module.description:
• Waterfront Living in Dubai Design District (d3): Enjoy tranquil views and a premium lifestyle in one of Dubai’s most creative and culturally rich neighborhoods.
  • Developed by Meraas: A trusted name in luxury real estate, Meraas is renowned for delivering visionary, design-led communities.
  • Artfully Designed Residences: Atelis showcases contemporary architecture with refined interiors, perfectly aligned with the artistic soul of d3.
  • Surrounded by Dubai’s Creative Pulse: Steps away from galleries, design studios, fashion houses, and cutting-edge cultural experiences.
  • World-Class Lifestyle Amenities: Includes wellness zones, waterfront promenades, lush greenery, and thoughtfully curated leisure spaces.
  • Strategic Location & Accessibility: Centrally located with seamless access to Downtown Dubai, Business Bay, and Dubai International Airport.

location_tile.title: Live in the World of Design, Art and Fashion
location_tile.heading: Location
location_tile.description:
Atelis by Meraas is strategically located in the heart of Dubai Design District (d3), a vibrant hub renowned for its fusion of art, fashion, and innovation. Residents of Atelis will immerse themselves in a community that hosts a plethora of design studios, art galleries, and upscale boutiques, fostering a creatively charged atmosphere. Dubai Design District by TECOM Group offers an array of dining experiences, from chic cafés to gourmet restaurants, catering to diverse culinary preferences.

  • 6 minutes – The Dubai Mall
  • 7 minutes – Downtown Dubai
  • 7 minutes – City Walk
  • 10 minutes – Burj Khalifa
  • 10 minutes – Business Bay
  • 12 minutes – DIFC
  • 15 minutes – DXB Airport

more_info.question: What is Atelis at D3 by Meraas?

Atelis offers a wide selection of units including:

1 to 4-bedroom apartments

4-bedroom Sky Villas

5-bedroom Penthouses
